intent: Create a bilingual (English/Japanese) documentation website for an open-source CLI tool, with search, versioned pages, and code examples.

spec.goal: Create a bilingual (English and Japanese) documentation website for an open-source CLI tool.
spec.deliverable: A documentation website with English and Japanese content, search, versioned pages, and code examples.
constraints: The site must be available in both English and Japanese.
The site must include a search function.
The site documents an open-source CLI tool.
done_criteria: The documentation is readable in both English and Japanese.
Documentation pages exist for more than one version, or are organised so versions can be selected.
Pages include code examples relevant to the CLI tool.
spec.summary: You want a bilingual English/Japanese documentation website for your open-source CLI tool, with search, versioned pages, and code examples.
